title: [Feature Request]: Support linux-loong64-gnu native binding
body:
### What problem does this feature solve?


When using Rolldown on the `linux-loong64-gnu` (LoongArch 64-bit) platform, `npm run build` (vite build) fails with an error indicating the native binding cannot be found:

```
Error: Cannot find native binding. npm has a bug related to optional dependencies
(https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/4828). Please try `npm i` again after removing both
package-lock.json and node_modules directory.
```

The root cause is that Rolldown currently does not provide a `@rolldown/binding-linux-loong64-gnu` native binary:

```
Error: Cannot find module '@rolldown/binding-linux-loong64-gnu'
...
Error: Cannot find module './rolldown-binding.linux-loong64-gnu.node'
```

Full error log:

```
$ npm run build
> artifact-admin@0.0.0 build
> run-p type-check "build-only {@}" --
> artifact-admin@0.0.0 type-check
> vue-tsc --build
> artifact-admin@0.0.0 build-only
> vite build
file:///.../node_modules/rolldown/dist/shared/binding-BmkJW3Wy.mjs:509
            const error = /* @__PURE__ */ new Error("Cannot find native binding. ...");
                                          ^
Error: Cannot find native binding. npm has a bug related to optional dependencies
(https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/4828). Please try `npm i` again after removing both
package-lock.json and node_modules directory.
    at file:///.../node_modules/rolldown/dist/shared/binding-BmkJW3Wy.mjs:509:34
    ...
    at requireNative (file:///.../node_modules/rolldown/dist/shared/binding-BmkJW3Wy.mjs:364:21)
    ...
    at CAC.<anonymous> (file:///.../node_modules/vite/dist/node/cli.js:763:28) {
  cause: Error: Cannot find module '@rolldown/binding-linux-loong64-gnu'
  Require stack:
  - /.../node_modules/rolldown/dist/shared/binding-BmkJW3Wy.mjs
      at Module._resolveFilename (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1517:15)
      ...
      at requireNative (file:///.../node_modules/rolldown/dist/shared/binding-BmkJW3Wy.mjs:364:21)

    code: 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND',
    requireStack: [
      '/.../node_modules/rolldown/dist/shared/binding-BmkJW3Wy.mjs'
    ],
    cause: Error: Cannot find module './rolldown-binding.linux-loong64-gnu.node'
    Require stack:
    - /.../node_modules/rolldown/dist/shared/binding-BmkJW3Wy.mjs
        at Module._resolveFilename (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1517:15)
        ...
        at requireNative (file:///.../node_modules/rolldown/dist/shared/binding-BmkJW3Wy.mjs:359:12)
        at file:///.../node_modules/rolldown/dist/shared/binding-BmkJW3Wy.mjs:475:18 {
      code: 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND',
      requireStack: [

}
Node.js v24.18.0
```

Environment info:
- Platform: linux-loong64-gnu (LoongArch 64-bit)
- Node.js: v24.18.0


### What does the proposed API look like?


Add native binding support for the `linux-loong64-gnu` platform by providing a prebuilt `.node` binary via the `@rolldown/binding-linux-loong64-gnu` package, enabling users on LoongArch 64-bit Linux systems to use Rolldown without issues.

Similar to existing platform bindings (e.g., `@rolldown/binding-linux-x64-gnu`, `@rolldown/binding-linux-arm64-gnu`), add:

```
@rolldown/binding-linux-loong64-gnu
```
